role: C2 retrospective exploratory intervention-comparison receipt, not prospective validation

fox_badger.target: badger proportion of true animal passes
fox_badger.design: 4000 half-split deterministic replays per CT position; 20 baseline camera triggers + 20 added triggers vs reference true passes (20/cost scenario)

otter.target: wet fraction of true otter passes
otter.match_rule: consecutive A/BS/BV camera triplets with identical event metadata; no externally verified unique pass ID

principal_result: On these externally collected real datasets, measurement-intervention class matters for ecological composition error, with cost- and context-dependent reversals.
principal_negative_result: The tested pilot diagnostic rules did not outperform the strongest always-AB10 fixed design; the unique prospective C2 prediction is not empirically confirmed.
claim_limits: Retrospective reuse after data and REC results were inspected, not protected validation
No measured money or deployment costs
Repeated passes and positions not independent biological replicates
Pilot diagnosis presumes reference truth available
